Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

surge antidote · evaluates: Antidote’s creator article has experts judge in their own fields with time to inspect answers, check citations and run code, emphasizing substantive usefulness, taste and candor rather than a quick preference impression.

Permanent record ID: candidate.add17.antidote.expert-review.v2

  • The month-later framing is an expert judgment target; the article does not describe a universal prospective month-long follow-up experiment.
